title: Game race event
description: Payloads delivered synchronously to the onEvent callback from inside Game.update() (public/display/engine/Game.js). All plain data. `id` is the car id in every event except rocket_expire, where it is the ROCKET's id. Exactly nine kinds. See docs/native-port/contract.md.

carId.description: Car id: peerIndex (number) in live games; strings for bots/tests/traces.

cause.description: What spun the car out: a dropped banana, an oil slick, a rocket hit, or a monster-truck body check.

spin.description: A car spins out (steering dies, speed bleeds, held item drops).

monster_end.description: The monster-truck transform timer lapses; the car morphs back.

rank.description: 1-based finish order (length of the finished list at crossing time).

time.description: Finish time: elapsed seconds of simulated race time at the crossing.

finish.description: A car crosses the line on its final lap. NOT emitted by the forceFinish staging hook (silent by design).

race_over.description: The last car finishes. Currently no production consumer (RaceSession polls the raceOver getter); kept in the contract.

lap.description: COMPLETED-lap count (not the 1-based display lap). The first crossing from the s < 0 starting grid emits nothing.

pad.description: A boost pad (or loop launch strip) crossed. No production consumer (boost FX are state-driven off boostMul); kept in the contract.

item.description: The item now held. For a finished car with a full slot this is the HELD item (the box pops but does not reroll).

finished.description: The collecting car had already finished.

item.description: The slot being fired. Emitted BEFORE the effect is applied.

item_use.description: A held item is fired (player ACTION press or the useItem staging hook).

id.description: The ROCKET's id (snapshot rockets[].id namespace), NOT a car id.

s.description: Arclength of the fizzle, wrapped to [0, track length). World units.

lat.description: Signed lateral offset of the fizzle; positive = right of travel. World units.

rocket_expire.description: A rocket self-destructs without hitting anything.
